subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: After the helper defect and dirty branch are fixed, should this external Feishu PR receive maintainer-provided live CardKit proof or a proof override, or should it be folded into the broader Feishu streaming-card work instead?
rationale: The contributor states they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus the affected streaming runtime, and automation cannot safely substitute the required real user-visible proof or decide whether to sponsor this branch.

options.title: Repair And Sponsor Proof
options.body: Fix the final-chunk heuristic, rebase the branch, and have a maintainer capture live Feishu proof or apply a documented proof override.

options.title: Require Contributor Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor can provide a redacted Feishu/CardKit recording or runtime log from a real setup.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Tracker
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card content-loss tracker.

recommendation.title: Repair And Sponsor Proof
recommendation.body: Fix the final-chunk heuristic, rebase the branch, and have a maintainer capture live Feishu proof or apply a documented proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee on the live PR and is best placed to decide whether to sponsor proof or route the fix elsewhere.
